seo.title: Palikir homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Palikir.

page.heading: PALIKIR - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Immediate danger: 911. Pohnpei Women's Council safe-house hotline: 923-2000. Pohnpei State Hospital: 320-2213 or 320-3805.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: Palikir is a small administrative capital. Most published services are in nearby Kolonia, about 8 kilometres away. Call first and confirm transport before travelling. No general walk-in homeless shelter is publicly listed; the Pohnpei Women's Council safe house is for people facing violence and requires contact or referral.
page.footer: Main sources: Pohnpei State Hospital, Pohnpei Women's Council, Micronesia Red Cross and Micronesian Legal Services Corporation.

entries.title: Pohnpei Women's Council safe-house hotline
entries.description: Emergency safe-house contact for people affected by gender-based violence. Placement and location are confidential.
entries.how_to_access: Call 923-2000. Use 911 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Pohnpei State Hospital
entries.description: Public hospital in nearby Kolonia for emergency and general medical care.
entries.how_to_access: Call 320-2213 or 320-3805, or travel to the hospital if safe.

entries.title: Pohnpei Women's Council safe house
entries.description: Confidential safe accommodation for survivors of violence. This is not a general homelessness shelter.
entries.how_to_access: Call the hotline. Do not attempt to locate the safe house directly.

entries.title: Micronesia Red Cross
entries.description: Humanitarian, health and disaster assistance from the national society based in Pohnpei. Support depends on assessed need and current programmes.
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit the office and explain the need. It is not a guaranteed daily shelter service.

entries.title: Pohnpei State Hospital
entries.description: Public hospital serving Pohnpei. Most services are in Kolonia rather than Palikir.
entries.how_to_access: Confirm transport from Palikir before travelling when possible.

entries.title: Pohnpei Family Health Clinic
entries.description: Private family-health clinic in Kolonia. Call first to confirm services, fees and current hours.
entries.how_to_access: Ask about charges before attending if the situation is not an emergency.

entries.title: Micronesian Legal Services Corporation - Pohnpei
entries.description: Civil legal assistance for eligible residents, with priorities including family safety, housing and economic stability.
entries.how_to_access: Call 320-2404 or 320-3762. New intake is normally on Mondays.

entries.title: Pohnpei Women's Council
entries.description: Confidential crisis support and safe-house referral for survivors of violence.
entries.how_to_access: Call the hotline or 911 if there is immediate danger.
